name: GPT-4o
description: OpenAI's flagship multimodal model supporting text, image, audio input and output in a unified architecture. Serves as the primary model powering ChatGPT and is available via API for developers.
notes: GPT-4o is a distinct model from GPT-4 Turbo. Supports native audio and image I/O. Accessible via OpenAI API (usage-based pricing) and via ChatGPT consumer product (separate record). Context window: 128K tokens. Not open-weight; proprietary model.

name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
description: Anthropic's flagship language model offering strong performance across coding, reasoning, instruction-following, and multimodal understanding. Available via API and as the default model powering claude.ai.
notes: Claude 3.5 Sonnet is part of the Claude 3.5 model family. Context window: 200K tokens. Proprietary, closed-weight model. Vision capabilities supported. Claude 3.5 Haiku is a lighter, faster sibling model (cataloged separately if added). Not to be confused with the Claude consumer product (tool:claude).

name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
description: Google DeepMind's long-context multimodal model supporting text, images, audio, video, and code with a 1 million-token context window. Accessible through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.
notes: Gemini 1.5 Pro supports up to 1M token context window (2M in certain API tiers). Proprietary, closed-weight model by Google DeepMind. Available via Gemini API and Google AI Studio. Distinct from Gemini 2.0 Flash and Gemini Ultra variants.

name: DeepSeek-R1
description: Open-weight reasoning model from DeepSeek using reinforcement learning to achieve strong performance on mathematics, coding, and logical reasoning tasks. Weights released under the MIT License.
notes: Released under MIT License — commercial use permitted with broad freedom. DeepSeek-R1 is a 671B MoE model. Distilled variants (e.g., DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B) are smaller, separately available models based on Qwen and Llama architectures. Full R1 requires significant GPU infrastructure; distilled variants run on consumer hardware.

name: Llama 3.1
description: Meta AI's family of open-weight large language models available in 8B, 70B, and 405B parameter sizes with a 128K token context window. Supports multilingual tasks, reasoning, coding, and tool use.
notes: Released under the Llama 3.1 Community License — not a fully OSI-approved open-source license. Commercial use permitted for most developers; entities with >700M MAU must request a separate license from Meta. Download requires signing Meta's license on Hugging Face.

name: Mistral Large
description: Mistral AI's flagship proprietary language model for enterprise use, offering strong multilingual reasoning, coding, and instruction-following performance. Accessible via the Mistral API and La Plateforme.
notes: Mistral Large is a proprietary closed-weight model. Distinct from Mistral's open-weight models such as Mistral 7B and Mixtral 8x7B. Available via the Mistral API (La Plateforme). Context window: 128K tokens.

name: Qwen2.5
description: Alibaba's Qwen2.5 series of open-weight language models available from 0.5B to 72B parameters, with strong performance in coding (Qwen2.5-Coder), mathematics (Qwen2.5-Math), and multilingual instruction following.
notes: Released by Alibaba Cloud under the Qwen License (Apache 2.0 for sub-72B models; larger models have additional commercial terms). Qwen2.5-Coder and Qwen2.5-Math are specialized sub-variants. The 72B model has separate license restrictions for large-scale commercial deployments.

name: FLUX.1 [schnell]
description: Fast text-to-image diffusion model from Black Forest Labs designed for local inference, generating high-quality images in 1–4 steps using Latent Adversarial Diffusion Distillation. Released under Apache 2.0 license.
notes: FLUX.1 [schnell] is the open-source, commercially permissive variant (Apache 2.0). FLUX.1 [dev] uses a non-commercial license and is cataloged separately. FLUX.1 [pro] is proprietary API-only. Schnell is optimized for speed and local inference; 12B parameter model.

name: Whisper
description: Open-source automatic speech recognition model from OpenAI trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual audio data. Supports transcription and translation in 99+ languages. Weights freely available for local use.
notes: Released under the MIT License. Multiple size variants available: tiny, base, small, medium, large, large-v2, large-v3. The OpenAI Whisper API (hosted version) is priced separately at \$0.006/minute. This record covers the open-source model, not the API service.

name: text-embedding-3-large
description: OpenAI's high-performance text embedding model producing dense vector representations for semantic search, RAG, and classification tasks. Outperforms ada-002 on MTEB benchmarks with configurable output dimensions.
notes: Proprietary, closed-weight model. Supports dimensions up to 3072 with shortening capability. Priced at \$0.13/million tokens. API-only; no local execution. text-embedding-3-small is a faster, cheaper sibling model.

name: Stable Diffusion 3.5
description: Stability AI's text-to-image diffusion model featuring improved prompt adherence, image quality, and typography generation. Available in Large (8B) and Medium (2.5B) variants with weights downloadable under a community license.
notes: SD 3.5 weights are available under the Stability AI Community License — free for non-commercial and commercial use with restrictions on large-scale API deployments. Requires acceptance on HuggingFace before download. Architecture: Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT).

name: Phi-3
description: Microsoft Research's family of small language models (3.8B–14B parameters) designed for efficient local inference on resource-constrained hardware. Offers strong reasoning performance relative to model size.
notes: Phi-3 Mini (3.8B), Phi-3 Small (7B), and Phi-3 Medium (14B) available. Released under MIT License — commercially permissive. Phi-3.5 and Phi-4 are successor versions. Designed for on-device and edge deployment scenarios.

name: Command R+
description: Cohere's enterprise-focused language model optimized for RAG pipelines, tool use, and multi-step agent workflows. Supports 10+ languages and excels at instruction following for business applications.
notes: Open weights released under Creative Commons NC license (non-commercial for weights). The hosted API via Cohere is commercial and usage-based. Context window: 128K tokens. A successor, Command R+08-2024, was subsequently released.

name: BGE-M3
description: Multi-functionality, multi-linguality, and multi-granularity text embedding model from BAAI. Supports dense retrieval, sparse retrieval, and multi-vector retrieval in 100+ languages. Open-source under MIT License.
notes: Published by BAAI (Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence). Supports dense, sparse (BM25-like), and multi-vector (ColBERT-style) retrieval in a single model. MIT License permits commercial use. Max sequence length: 8192 tokens.

name: Falcon 180B
description: Open-weight large language model from the Technology Innovation Institute with 180 billion parameters, trained on 3.5 trillion tokens of the RefinedWeb dataset. Supports text generation and completion tasks.
notes: Released under the Falcon-180B TII License — allows commercial use with conditions. Requires significant GPU resources for full inference (e.g., multiple A100s or H100s). Falcon 7B and 40B are smaller, more accessible variants. TII is based in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

name: MusicGen
description: Open-source text-to-music and melody-conditioned music generation model from Meta AI AudioCraft. Generates high-quality stereo audio from text descriptions and optional melodic conditioning inputs.
notes: Released under the MIT License. Part of Meta's AudioCraft framework alongside AudioGen. Available in small, medium, and large variants. Runs locally via Python/PyTorch. Distinct from commercial music generation products.

name: OpenAI o1
description: OpenAI's frontier reasoning model designed to spend inference time thinking before producing answers. Uses reinforcement learning to execute long chain-of-thought reasoning across competitive math, coding, and scientific research benchmarks.
notes: Includes full o1 and lighter o1-mini variants. Available via OpenAI API (usage-based token billing) and ChatGPT Plus/Pro. Chains of thought are hidden from users; summary reasoning tokens are billed as part of output.

name: Gemma 2
description: Family of lightweight open-weight models (2.6B, 9B, and 27B parameters) from Google DeepMind built upon Gemini research. Features sliding-window attention and knowledge distillation for exceptional single-GPU efficiency.
notes: Distributed under the permissive Gemma Terms of Use allowing commercial development. Trained on up to 13 trillion tokens. Available in Base and Instruct (IT) variants across standard 8K context windows.

name: Claude 3.5 Haiku
description: Anthropic's fastest language model in the Claude 3.5 family. Delivers coding, text analysis, and instruction-following performance matching prior flagship Claude 3 Opus at high inference speeds and low per-token operational cost.
notes: Proprietary closed model. Features 200K token context window. Highly suited for customer-facing chatbots, rapid code review, and high-volume background processing pipelines.

name: DeepSeek-V3
description: Open-weight 671-billion parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model (activating 37B parameters per token) developed by DeepSeek. Features Multi-head Latent Attention and auxiliary-loss-free load balancing for cost-effective inference.
notes: Weights released under the DeepSeek Model License allowing commercial use and distillation. Context window: 128K tokens. Acts as the base model from which DeepSeek-R1 was trained.

name: Llama 3.2
description: Meta's multimodal open-weight collection offering 11B and 90B vision-language models alongside 1B and 3B lightweight edge text models. Optimized for mobile, on-device computing, and visual document analysis across 128K context windows.
notes: Released under Llama 3.2 Community License. Requires license acceptance on Hugging Face. 1B and 3B models run on Qualcomm and MediaTek mobile chipsets; 11B and 90B handle image-text reasoning.

name: Codestral
description: Mistral AI's 22-billion parameter open-weight language model trained on 80+ programming languages. Features a 32K context window with fill-in-the-middle capabilities for IDE autocompletions and codebase refactoring.
notes: Distributed under the Mistral Non-Production License for research and testing; commercial usage requires licensing through Mistral API or cloud partners. Distinct from general-purpose Mistral models.

name: Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM 2)
description: Meta FAIR's foundation model for real-time visual promptable object segmentation across both static images and dynamic video frames, tracking target object masks continuously through occlusions and camera perspective shifts.
notes: Code and model weights released under the permissive Apache 2.0 License allowing commercial utilization. Features interactive prompting via clicks, bounding boxes, or freeform mask inputs.

name: DINOv2
description: Vision foundation model developed by Meta FAIR using self-supervised learning without text supervision. Produces universal visual features for monocular depth estimation, semantic segmentation, and image retrieval.
notes: Released under Apache 2.0 license. Available in ViT-S, ViT-B, ViT-L, and ViT-g parameter sizes. Delivers dense visual descriptors directly usable by linear classifiers without fine-tuning.

name: CLIP
description: OpenAI's foundational vision-language model trained on 400 million image-text pairs via contrastive learning. Maps images and text into a shared embedding space to enable zero-shot image classification and semantic multimodal search.
notes: Released under MIT License. Serves as the fundamental vision-text alignment backbone powering Stable Diffusion guidance, DALL-E priors, and multimodal vector databases.

name: HunyuanVideo
description: Tencent's 13-billion parameter open-source video generation model utilizing a unified dual-stream and single-stream diffusion transformer. Generates high-definition (720p/1080p) cinema-grade video clips with physical dynamics.
notes: Released under Apache 2.0 license for code and Tencent Hunyuan Community License for weights. Supports high-fidelity 54-frame video clips. ComfyUI workflow wrappers widely adopted by local AI communities.

name: CogVideoX
description: Open-source text-to-video diffusion transformer model developed by THUDM and Zhipu AI. Employs 3D Variational Autoencoders and expert transformer backends to produce coherent 6-second video clips up to 4K resolution.
notes: Available in 2B and 5B parameter sizes under Apache 2.0 and custom community licensing. Features prompt refinement via integrated vision-language processing.

name: Voyage-3
description: High-performance text embedding model engineered by Voyage AI delivering top retrieval accuracy on the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB). Optimized for domain-specific RAG pipelines across finance, code, and legal documents.
notes: Proprietary cloud model accessed via REST API. Context length: 32,000 tokens with 1024-dimensional outputs. Official default embedding partner for Anthropic Claude integrations.

name: Cohere Embed v3
description: Cohere's enterprise embedding model family supporting 100+ languages and multimodal image-text searches. Outperforms previous generations in noisy document retrieval using compression-aware quantization embeddings.
notes: Cloud API model offering `embed-english-v3.0` and `embed-multilingual-v3.0`. Supports int8 and binary embedding outputs to shrink vector database memory footprints by up to 90%.

name: XTTS-v2
description: Deep learning text-to-speech foundation model from Coqui capable of realistic voice cloning across 17 languages from a 3-second audio reference sample without extensive speaker fine-tuning.
notes: Released under the Coqui Public Model License (CPML), which permits non-commercial and research use while requiring licensing for commercial distribution. Community maintenance ongoing via open-source forks.

name: Mistral NeMo
description: 12-billion parameter multilingual foundation model co-developed by Mistral AI and NVIDIA. Features a 128K context window and the Tekken tokenizer for efficient multilingual inference and code synthesis.
notes: Released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license. Drop-in replacement for systems utilizing Mistral 7B with significantly improved reasoning and multi-language fluency.

name: Jina Embeddings v3
description: Open-source 570M parameter embedding model supporting 8192-token context lengths across 89 languages. Uses task-specific LoRA adapters to optimize vectors for retrieval, classification, clustering, and semantic matching.
notes: Weights published under CC-BY-NC 4.0; commercial use available via Jina AI API platform. Features 5 distinct task-tailored vector spaces through dynamic adapter routing.

name: Gemini 1.5 Flash
description: Google DeepMind's lightweight, low-latency multimodal foundation model. Optimized for high-frequency tasks, cost efficiency, and massive 1-million-token context processing across text, audio, images, and video feeds.
notes: Accessible via Google AI Studio (with a free tier) and Google Cloud Vertex AI. Distilled from Gemini 1.5 Pro to deliver sub-second time-to-first-token for high-volume multimodal applications.

name: GPT-4o mini
description: OpenAI's cost-efficient small multimodal model replacing GPT-3.5 Turbo. Supports text and vision inputs with a 128K context window, scoring strongly on reasoning, coding, and mathematical benchmarks at a fraction of flagship model costs.
notes: Priced at $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 per million output tokens. Powers standard free-tier interactions in ChatGPT and high-volume background API workloads.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder
description: Code-specialized open-weight model series from Alibaba Cloud ranging from 0.5B to 32B parameters. Trained on 5.5 trillion tokens of source code, technical documentation, and synthetic coding datasets with a 128K context window.
notes: Flagship 32B model matches GPT-4o on major code evaluation benchmarks (EvalPlus, MultiPL-E). Released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license for unrestricted commercial use.

name: Qwen2-VL
description: Vision-language model family from Alibaba (2B, 7B, 72B) featuring NaViT dynamic image resolution architecture. Accurately reads arbitrary aspect-ratio images, interprets fine document text, and parses video events with second-level grounding.
notes: 2B and 7B models released under Apache 2.0; 72B model uses the Qwen License. Processes high-definition documents, scans, charts, and 20+ minute video clips seamlessly without fixed grid distortion.

name: DeepSeek-Coder-V2
description: Open-source Mixture-of-Experts language model for code and mathematics supporting 338 programming languages and a 128K context window. Available in 16B (2.4B active) and 236B (21B active) parameter scales.
notes: Released under the MIT License for the Lite version and DeepSeek License for the 236B version. Demonstrates competitive performance with closed frontier models on HumanEval and MBPP.

name: Pixtral 12B
description: 12-billion parameter multimodal language model trained by Mistral AI. Integrates a custom 400M parameter vision encoder to natively reason over arbitrary images, documents, and technical charts alongside natural text across a 128K context window.
notes: Released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license. Retains state-of-the-art text understanding capabilities from Mistral NeMo while adding zero-shot diagram and document reading abilities.

name: FLUX.1 [dev]
description: 12-billion parameter open-weight rectified flow transformer model from Black Forest Labs. Delivers state-of-the-art text-to-image quality, photorealistic skin textures, accurate multi-word typography, and detailed prompt comprehension.
notes: Distributed under the FLUX.1 [dev] Non-Commercial License for research and personal use. Direct guidance-distilled version of FLUX.1 [pro] yielding competitive image fidelity in approximately 28–50 sampling steps.

name: Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL)
description: Stability AI's flagship 3.5-billion parameter latent diffusion model engineered for native 1024x1024 resolution image generation. Uses a base model followed by an ensemble refiner model to render intricate backgrounds and realistic lighting.
notes: Released under the CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M License allowing commercial deployment. Extremely broad ecosystem of community fine-tunes, LoRA checkpoints, ControlNets, and ComfyUI workflows.

name: Kolors
description: Open-source text-to-image diffusion model developed by Kuaishou's Kolors Team. Built with the ChatGLM language model as its text encoder to achieve nuanced bilingual understanding (Chinese and English) and high-quality typography rendering.
notes: Code released under Apache 2.0; model weights distributed under the Kolors Community License allowing commercial use after registration. Highly praised for photorealistic human portraits and Asian cultural aesthetics.

name: Bark
description: Transformer-based text-to-audio foundation model created by Suno. Generates realistic multilingual speech, non-verbal vocalizations (laughter, sighs, clearing throat), background ambient sounds, and basic music from text prompts.
notes: Released under the MIT License for open commercial use. Uses EnCodec tokens and GPT-style autoregressive transformers rather than conventional acoustic spectrogram models.

name: Whisper large-v3-turbo
description: Fine-tuned, pruned variant of OpenAI's Whisper large-v3 model. Reduces the number of decoder layers from 32 to 4 to deliver an 8x speedup in multilingual audio transcription and translation with minimal loss in accuracy.
notes: MIT-licensed open-source model. Optimized for real-time edge speech recognition pipelines, live call transcription, and low-latency audio processing servers.

name: BGE Reranker-v2
description: Multilingual cross-encoder reranking model series (m3 and gemma variants) developed by the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence. Computes deep relevance scores between queries and retrieved passages to dramatically boost RAG precision.
notes: MIT License allows commercial applications. Applied as a second-stage reranker after initial bi-encoder vector search in retrieval pipelines to re-score candidate documents.

name: Cohere Rerank 3
description: Enterprise cross-encoder foundation model from Cohere engineered for semantic reranking of search results across 100+ languages, semi-structured JSON objects, emails, code snippets, and noisy web documents.
notes: Cloud API accessed via `rerank-v3.5`. Supports context lengths up to 4096 tokens per document chunk. Integrates with Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Pinecone, and Qdrant search stacks.

name: InternVL 2.0
description: Open-source multimodal foundation model family developed by OpenGVLab ranging from 1B to 108B parameters. Achieves top scores in multimodal benchmarks, chart understanding, OCR, document analysis, and video grounding.
notes: Released under Apache 2.0 license for code and model weights. Features dynamic image tiling allowing high-resolution inputs (up to 4K) without downsampling degradation.

name: Molmo 72B
description: Open multimodal vision-language model developed by the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2). Outperforms proprietary models on academic benchmarks using open datasets and transparent human-collected visual pointing annotations.
notes: Built using Qwen2-72B as the base LLM combined with an open CLIP vision backbone. Weights released under Apache 2.0 alongside open training code, evaluation harnesses, and datasets.

name: Moondream2
description: Compact 1.6-billion parameter vision-language model engineered to run locally on edge hardware, mobile phones, and Raspberry Pi devices. Capable of visual question answering, image captioning, and object detection.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Combines SigLIP visual embeddings with the Phi-1.5 language model to deliver real-time visual reasoning with negligible RAM and compute footprint.

name: OpenAI o3-mini
description: OpenAI's cost-efficient reasoning model engineered for STEM tasks, competitive coding, and multi-step mathematics. Features user-configurable reasoning effort levels (low, medium, high) and supports developer tool-calling within chain-of-thought workflows.
notes: Replaces o1-mini with higher coding and math benchmark accuracy at the same low cost ($1.10/M input tokens, $4.40/M output tokens). Introduces developer parameters to dynamically throttle reasoning compute budgets per request.

name: Llama 3
description: Meta AI's foundational open-weight language model family released in 8B and 70B parameter architectures. Trained on over 15 trillion tokens using custom GPU clusters, establishing early industry benchmarks for open-weights performance.
notes: Released under the Meta Llama 3 Community License. Initial release featured an 8K token context window and tiktoken-based 128k tokenizer. Predecessor to Llama 3.1 (which expanded context to 128k tokens).

name: Mistral 7B
description: Foundational 7.3-billion parameter open-weight language model from Mistral AI. Employs Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and Sliding Window Attention (SWA) to deliver high inference throughput and outscore larger 13B models across benchmarks.
notes: Released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license for unrestricted commercial use. Widely adopted as the base architecture for thousands of community fine-tunes, domain models, and quantized local builds.

name: Mixtral 8x7B
description: High-performance sparse Mixture-of-Experts model from Mistral AI with 46.7B total parameters. Routes each token through 2 of 8 expert subnetworks (activating 12.9B parameters per token) to deliver 70B-grade reasoning at 14B execution speeds.
notes: Released under the Apache 2.0 license. Supports 32K token context length across English, French, German, Spanish, and Italian with exceptional code generation capabilities.

name: Mixtral 8x22B
description: Large-scale sparse Mixture-of-Experts model from Mistral AI with 141B total parameters, activating 39B parameters per token. Features a 64K token context window, native function calling, and strong multilingual mathematical reasoning.
notes: Released under Apache 2.0 license. Provides one of the highest parameter capacities of any permissively licensed open-source model available for enterprise self-hosting.

name: Qwen2.5-Math
description: Open-weight specialized mathematical model family from Alibaba Cloud (1.5B, 7B, 72B). Trained exclusively on mathematical web text, synthesis datasets, and step-by-step chain-of-thought proofs to solve advanced competition-grade problems.
notes: Released under Apache 2.0 for 1.5B and 7B models; 72B model uses the Qwen License. Incorporates both English and Chinese mathematical notations and code-interpreter verification steps.

name: DeepSeek-V2.5
description: Open-source foundation model from DeepSeek that unifies general conversational capabilities from DeepSeek-V2-Chat with coding reasoning from DeepSeek-Coder-V2 into a single 236B Mixture-of-Experts architecture.
notes: Released under the DeepSeek Model License allowing commercial use. Context window: 128K tokens. Acts as the intermediate milestone between DeepSeek-V2 and the frontier DeepSeek-V3 architecture.

name: Gemma
description: Google DeepMind's first-generation suite of lightweight open-weight models (2B and 7B parameters) built from Gemini research, engineered for responsible AI development, text completion, and on-device execution.
notes: Released under Gemma Terms of Use. Predecessor to Gemma 2. Available in pre-trained base and instruction-tuned variants with optimized cross-platform toolkits for JAX, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers.

name: Stable Audio Open
subtype: Open Audio & Sound Effect Generation Model
description: Open-weight audio generation model by Stability AI capable of generating up to 47 seconds of high-fidelity 44.1kHz stereo audio, ambient sound effects, musical instrument samples, and Foley sounds from text descriptions.

verified_link.title: Stable Audio Open on Hugging Face

notes: Released under Stability AI Community License for non-commercial research use. Uses a diffusion transformer (DiT) architecture conditioned on T5 text embeddings. Not designed for full singing vocal generation.

name: Stable Video Diffusion (SVD)
description: Open-weight latent video diffusion model developed by Stability AI that generates smooth 14 to 25-frame video clips from single static images, supporting camera trajectory controls, motion conditioning, and multi-view generation.
notes: Released under the Stability AI Community License. Available in SVD and SVD-XT (extended 25 frames) variants. Foundational model widely integrated into local automatic video synthesis pipelines and ComfyUI.

name: Minitron
subtype: Pruned & Distilled Edge Language Model Family
description: Family of compact language models (4B and 8B) created by NVIDIA through structured depth and width pruning of larger Llama 3.1 and Nemotron foundation models, fine-tuned with knowledge distillation for high edge efficiency.
notes: Released under the NVIDIA Open Model License. Demonstrates how structured compression can reproduce 8B-tier performance with up to 40x less training compute than training from scratch.

name: Jukebox
subtype: Neural Network for Raw Audio Music Generation
description: OpenAI's generative neural network for music that produces songs in raw audio format across diverse genres and artist styles, synthesizing singing vocals, lyrics, and complex musical instrumentation simultaneously.
notes: MIT-licensed code and pre-trained weights. Uses multi-scale VQ-VAE to compress raw audio into discrete tokens, followed by autoregressive transformers. Groundbreaking early demonstration of end-to-end singing music synthesis.

name: E5 Embeddings
description: Family of dense text embedding models developed by Microsoft Research using weakly-supervised contrastive pre-training on billions of text pairs (CCPairs), consistently ranking among top models on the MTEB benchmark.
notes: MIT-licensed. Available in Small, Base, Large, and Multilingual (mE5) variants. Requires query prefix instructions (e.g. `query: ` and `passage: `) to optimize asymmetric retrieval performance.

name: Nomic Embed Text
subtype: Fully Open-Source Long-Context Text Embedding Model
description: High-performance text embedding model with an 8192-token context window developed by Nomic AI. Completely reproducible with fully open model weights, training codebase, and raw training dataset.
notes: Released under Apache 2.0 license. Features Matryoshka representation learning allowing dimension truncation down to 64, 128, or 256 dimensions with minimal degradation in search accuracy.

name: YOLOv8
description: Real-time computer vision model family created by Ultralytics. Provides state-of-the-art speeds and accuracy across object detection, instance segmentation, oriented bounding box detection, pose estimation, and image classification.
notes: Open-source under AGPL-3.0; commercial enterprise licenses available directly from Ultralytics. Features an anchor-free split-head architecture exportable to ONNX, TensorRT, CoreML, and TFLite for edge deployment.

name: Grounding DINO
description: Open-set object detection foundation model developed by IDEA-Research. Marries DINO vision transformer detection with language grounding to detect arbitrary objects in images specified by free-form human text queries.
notes: Released under the Apache 2.0 license. Frequently paired with Segment Anything (SAM) in visual AI pipelines (Grounded-SAM) to generate automatic pixel-level segmentation masks from natural language descriptions.

name: Phi-4
description: 14-billion parameter open-weight language model developed by Microsoft Research. Trained on synthetic reasoning datasets and curated textbook content, achieving state-of-the-art performance on mathematical and logical benchmarks rivaling models several times its size.
notes: Released under the permissive MIT license allowing commercial fine-tuning and deployment. 16K token context window. Sets new state-of-the-art records for sub-15B parameter models on GPQA, MATH, and HumanEval benchmarks.

name: CodeGemma
description: Family of lightweight open-weight models from Google DeepMind specialized for code generation and completion (2B, 7B). Trained on 500+ billion tokens of English web text, mathematics, and code to deliver fast fill-in-the-middle IDE suggestions.
notes: Distributed under the Gemma Terms of Use. Available in a 2B dedicated fill-in-the-middle code completion variant and 7B pretrained and instruction-tuned conversational coding variants.

name: StarCoder2
description: Next-generation open-access code model family (3B, 7B, 15B parameters) developed by the BigCode Project, ServiceNow, and Hugging Face. Trained on the responsibly curated Stack v2 dataset across 600+ programming languages.
notes: Released under the OpenRAIL-M license allowing commercial usage. Features 16K token context windows. Built with strict opt-out compliance protocols honoring developer data rights on GitHub.

name: DeepSeek-VL2
description: Advanced open-weight vision-language model family from DeepSeek built on a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. Excels at high-resolution visual processing, technical diagram comprehension, document OCR, and grounded visual reasoning.
notes: Released under the DeepSeek Model License allowing commercial usage and distillation. Available in Tiny (1B active), Small (2.8B active), and Base (4.5B active) parameter configurations with dynamic image tiling.

name: LLaVA-NeXT
description: Leading open-source large multimodal model architecture developed by academic researchers. Employs dynamic high-resolution image tiling to dramatically improve visual document understanding, OCR accuracy, and multimodal conversation.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed code. Available using varied language backends including Llama 3, Mistral, and Qwen. Serves as the community benchmark foundation for open-source visual reasoning research.

name: Florence-2
description: Lightweight vision foundation model developed by Microsoft with a unified prompt-based representation. Handles diverse computer vision tasks including captioning, object detection, dense region descriptions, and visual grounding with a single model.
notes: MIT-licensed. Available in Base (0.23B) and Large (0.77B) sizes. Trained on the massive FLD-5B dataset consisting of 5.4 billion visual annotations, making it exceptionally fast for edge device deployment.

name: Segment Anything Model 1 (SAM 1)
description: Meta FAIR's foundational computer vision model for image segmentation. Trained on the SA-1B dataset of 1 billion masks, it cuts out any object in any image with a single interactive foreground point or bounding box prompt.
notes: Released under the Apache 2.0 license. Predecessor to SAM 2. The SA-1B dataset and model weights established the zero-shot promptable segmentation paradigm across the computer vision industry.

name: Depth Anything V2
description: State-of-the-art monocular depth estimation foundation model developed by ByteDance and the University of Hong Kong. Predicts robust, high-granularity metric and relative depth maps from arbitrary indoor and outdoor images.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Outperforms complex sensor-based depth estimators by training on massive synthetic data with synthetic-to-real distillation. Widely used for spatial computing, robotics, and 3D Gaussian splatting.

name: FastSAM
description: High-speed, real-time approximation of the Segment Anything task formulated using the YOLOv8-seg instance segmentation architecture. Delivers 50x faster inference speeds than SAM, running at real-time video framerates.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Processes 1080p images in ~40ms on consumer GPUs, making zero-shot interactive segmentation practical for edge robotics, autonomous vehicles, and real-time video pipelines.

name: Stable Diffusion 2.1
description: Open text-to-image latent diffusion model released by Stability AI. Trained using an OpenCLIP text encoder to generate 768x768 resolution images, supporting depth-guided generation and text-conditioned inpainting pipelines.
notes: Distributed under the CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M License allowing commercial use. Features a 768x768 base model and an architecture for depth2img that guides novel image generation using monocular depth maps.

name: ControlNet
subtype: Spatial Conditioning Architecture for Diffusion Models
description: Neural network architecture that adds spatial conditioning controls to text-to-image diffusion models. Locks original model weights while training trainable copies to guide generations using edge maps, human pose skeletons, or depth maps.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Created by Lvmin Zhang and Maneesh Agrawala. Revolutionized diffusion modeling by enabling exact compositional control (OpenPose, Canny edges, depth, normal maps) without prompt guessing.

name: AnimateDiff
subtype: Text-to-Video Motion Module for Diffusion Models
description: Motion-conditioned animation module that transforms personalized text-to-image diffusion checkpoints into smooth animated video generators without requiring task-specific fine-tuning of the base image weights.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Inserts newly trained motion modeling modules between the frozen self-attention layers of Stable Diffusion, enabling widespread community video generation within ComfyUI and Automatic1111.

name: TripoSR
description: Fast feed-forward 3D reconstruction model co-developed by Stability AI and VAST AI. Generates textured 3D polygon meshes from a single 2D image in less than 0.5 seconds on consumer GPUs without multi-step optimization.
notes: Released under the MIT License for open commercial applications. Built upon the Large Reconstruction Model (LRM) transformer architecture, outputting explicit Textured 3D OBJ meshes ready for 3D game engines.

name: InstantMesh
description: Open-source feed-forward framework developed by Tencent ARC for generating high-quality textured 3D meshes from a single image in approximately 10 seconds. Combines multi-view diffusion with sparse-view large reconstruction transformers.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Generates smooth geometry without the typical noise artifacts of NeRF-based extraction, exporting watertight OBJ and GLTF files directly usable in Blender, Unreal Engine, and Unity.

name: Chronos
subtype: Pretrained Time-Series Forecasting Foundation Model Family
description: Family of pretrained foundation models developed by Amazon Science for probabilistic time-series forecasting. Tokenizes real-valued time-series data into discrete scaling bins, training autoregressive T5 architectures for zero-shot forecasting.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed. Outperforms traditional statistical models (ARIMA, ETS) and task-specific deep learning architectures zero-shot on unseen datasets without requiring custom parameter tuning.

name: WhisperX
description: High-performance speech recognition pipeline built upon Whisper. Integrates forced phoneme alignment using wav2vec 2.0 and voice activity detection (PyAnnote) to deliver 70x faster-than-real-time transcription with precise word timestamps and speaker diarization.
notes: BSD-2-Clause licensed. Solves Whisper's timestamp drift and hallucination issues on long-form audio files. Employs faster-whisper (CTranslate2) quantization backends to minimize GPU VRAM consumption.

name: PaliGemma 2
description: Google's lightweight open vision-language model family combining a SigLIP vision encoder with Gemma 2 language models across 3B, 10B, and 28B parameter checkpoints for image captioning, VQA, OCR, and spatial object detection.
notes: Canonical ID: model:paligamma-2. Official primary domain: deepmind.google. Verified via public documentation.

name: SmolLM2
description: Hugging Face's lightweight open-weight language model family available in 135M, 360M, and 1.7B parameter sizes, pre-trained on high-quality synthetic datasets and designed for on-device inference in resource-constrained environments.
notes: Canonical ID: model:smollm2. Official primary domain: huggingface.co. Verified via public documentation.

name: ESM3
description: Frontier biological foundation model from EvolutionaryScale that simultaneously reasons over protein sequence, 3D structure, and biological function to generate novel functional proteins and advance programmable biology.
notes: Canonical ID: model:esm3. Official primary domain: evolutionaryscale.ai. Verified via public documentation.

name: AlphaFold 3
description: DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs breakthrough model predicting the 3D structures and interactions of all life molecules, including proteins, DNA, RNA, ligands, and chemical modifications with atomic accuracy.
notes: Canonical ID: model:alphafold-3. Official primary domain: deepmind.google. Verified via public documentation.

name: SeamlessM4T
description: Meta AI's unified foundational speech and text model capable of speech-to-speech, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and text-to-text translation across nearly 100 spoken languages with expressive voice preservation.
notes: Canonical ID: model:seamlessm4t. Official primary domain: ai.meta.com. Verified via public documentation.

name: OpenVoice
description: Open-source voice cloning model from MyShell and MIT that replicates a speaker's unique vocal timbre from a short audio snippet while providing flexible, independent control over emotion, accent, rhythm, and language.
notes: Canonical ID: model:openvoice. Official primary domain: myshell.ai. Verified via public documentation.

name: Solar 10.7B
description: High-performing open-weights language model built by Upstage using Depth Up-Scaling (DUS) methodology, combining modified base layers to outscore larger models on reasoning, instruction compliance, and mathematical benchmarks.
notes: Canonical ID: model:solar-10-7b. Official primary domain: upstage.ai. Verified via public documentation.

name: MiniCPM-V
description: Open-source multimodal foundation model series designed by OpenBMB and Tsinghua for efficient on-device vision-language tasks, high-resolution document parsing, spatial bounding box detection, and live video stream understanding.
notes: Canonical ID: model:minicpm-v. Official primary domain: openbmb.org. Verified via public documentation.

name: Video-LLaVA
description: Multimodal alignment model that binds images and video representations into a unified feature space before projecting them into an LLM, enabling synchronized spatio-temporal reasoning, video captioning, and conversational video QA.
notes: Canonical ID: model:video-llava. Official primary domain: github.com. Verified via public documentation.

name: BioGPT
description: Microsoft Research's specialized domain-specific generative language model pre-trained on massive collections of PubMed biomedical literature, excelling at biomedical relation extraction, text classification, and medical question answering.
notes: Canonical ID: model:biogpt. Official primary domain: microsoft.com. Verified via public documentation.

name: Command R
description: Cohere's 35B parameter open-weights foundation model optimized specifically for enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-step tool interactions, and grounded text generation across 10 global business languages.
notes: Canonical ID: model:command-r. Official primary domain: cohere.com. Verified via public documentation.

name: MMS (Massively Multilingual Speech)
description: Meta AI's speech technology suite providing automatic speech recognition for over 1,100 languages, text-to-speech for over 1,400 languages, and language identification across 4,000 spoken languages.
notes: Canonical ID: model:mms-meta. Official primary domain: ai.meta.com. Verified via public documentation.

name: Falcon 2 11B
description: Second-generation foundational model from the Technology Innovation Institute (TII) combining state-of-the-art 11B language reasoning with native vision-to-language capabilities for document understanding and visual question answering.
notes: Canonical ID: model:falcon-2-11b. Official primary domain: tii.ae. Verified via public documentation.

name: SegFormer
description: NVIDIA's lightweight, hierarchical vision transformer framework for semantic image segmentation that removes complex positional embeddings and yields high-accuracy multi-scale feature representations for autonomous driving and robotics.
notes: Canonical ID: model:segformer. Official primary domain: nvidia.com. Verified via public documentation.

name: InternVideo2
description: Large-scale foundation video model developed by OpenDataLab and Shanghai AI Lab that learns multi-modal representations for video-audio-text retrieval, action localization, fine-grained event parsing, and long-form video reasoning.
notes: Canonical ID: model:internvideo2. Official primary domain: opendatalab.com. Verified via public documentation.

name: Qwen2-Audio
description: Alibaba Cloud's audio-language model capable of directly ingesting complex voice, environmental sounds, and musical audio streams to perform speech recognition, sound event detection, emotion classification, and vocal chat.
notes: Canonical ID: model:qwen2-audio. Official primary domain: qwen.ai. Verified via public documentation.

name: Med-PaLM 2
description: Expert-level medical foundation model developed by Google Research, fine-tuned on clinical medical knowledge to answer healthcare queries, interpret clinical documentation, and achieve expert-level passing scores on USMLE medical exams.
notes: Deployed under limited preview to healthcare and life sciences customers on Google Cloud Vertex AI; evaluated by physician panels.

name: Code Llama
description: Meta AI's family of open code models built on Llama 2 checkpoints, available in 7B, 13B, 34B, and 70B parameter sizes, trained on 500B tokens of code and syntax to generate, debug, explain, and autocomplete code across Python, C++, Java, and Bash.
notes: Includes specialized CodeLlama-Python and CodeLlama-Instruct variants, supporting context windows up to 100K tokens with fill-in-the-middle (FIM) capabilities.

name: DeepSeek-Math
description: Open mathematical reasoning model developed by DeepSeek pre-trained on 120B math-related tokens from web text and literature, utilizing Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to reach competition-level mathematics accuracy.
notes: Released under the DeepSeek license; served as the experimental foundation for reinforcement learning techniques later scaled in DeepSeek-R1.

name: LLaVA-1.5
description: Seminal open-source multimodal visual assistant combining a CLIP-ViT-L-336px vision encoder with Vicuna LLMs using a simple MLP projection layer, setting the architectural blueprint for open vision-language models.
notes: Apache 2.0 code with open weights (7B and 13B); widely adopted across edge runtimes, llama.cpp, and academic benchmarks.

name: MusicLM
description: Google Research's conditional hierarchical sequence-to-sequence model generating high-fidelity 24 kHz music from complex natural language descriptions, humming melodies, or whistle inputs across diverse genres.
notes: Powered Google's experimental AI Test Kitchen MusicFX tool; generates contiguous multi-minute musical compositions.

name: DBRX
description: Databricks' 132B total parameter open Mixture-of-Experts language model activating 36B parameters across 16 fine-grained experts per token, delivering competitive efficiency and accuracy across programming and general knowledge benchmarks.
notes: Built using the MosaicML LLM training stack; licensed under the Databricks Open Model License allowing commercial use.

name: SD-Turbo (Stable Diffusion Turbo)
description: Fast text-to-image foundation model by Stability AI based on Adversarial Diffusion Distillation (ADD), enabling real-time photorealistic single-step image generation at 512x512 resolution with near-zero latency.
notes: Non-commercial research license on Hugging Face; achieves sub-100 millisecond inference on modern desktop NVIDIA RTX GPUs.

name: Latent Consistency Models (LCM)
description: High-speed generative distillation architecture that predicts solution trajectories in latent space, shrinking the generation process of Stable Diffusion from 25–50 sampling steps down to just 2 to 4 inference steps.
notes: LCM-LoRA adapters can be dynamically plugged into arbitrary SD 1.5, SD 2.1, and SDXL checkpoints to enable real-time image synthesis.

name: Distil-Whisper
description: Knowledge-distilled version of OpenAI's Whisper model designed by Hugging Face that runs 6x faster and is 50% smaller while maintaining within 1% Word Error Rate (WER) of the original Whisper-Large models.
notes: MIT licensed; particularly robust to background noise and hallucination in repetitive audio sections.

name: NV-Embed
description: NVIDIA's frontier generalist text embedding model that achieved top ranking on the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB), incorporating latent attention pooling and bidirectional instruction-aware tuning.
notes: CC-BY-NC-4.0 licensed; supports 4096 sequence context lengths and generalizes across both retrieval and classification tasks.

name: InstructPix2Pix
description: Pioneering conditional diffusion model trained on paired synthetic data generated by GPT-3 and Stable Diffusion to perform precise image editing directly from conversational instructions without masking.
notes: MIT licensed code; checks input images and text commands like "add fireworks to the sky" or "make it winter" to alter scenes realistically.

name: CogView3
description: Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University's open text-to-image diffusion model based on cascaded diffusion architectures, generating high-fidelity Chinese and English photorealistic visual imagery and graphic typography.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed code; implements relay diffusion stages to reduce computational overhead during high-resolution 1024x1024 synthesis.

name: YOLOS
subtype: Pure Vision Transformer Object Detection Model
description: Pure Vision Transformer (ViT) architecture adapted for 2D object detection from Huazhong University and ByteDance, discarding convolutional backbones and region proposals in favor of standard sequence-to-sequence representations.
notes: Checkpoints range from YOLOS-Ti (tiny) to YOLOS-B (base); integrated natively into Hugging Face Transformers.

name: TimesNet
description: Foundation deep learning framework for general time series analysis that transforms 1D temporal sequences into 2D tensor spaces based on multiple periodicities, capturing both intraperiod and interperiod variations for forecasting and anomaly detection.
notes: MIT licensed; outperforms standard Transformer time-series models across short-term forecasting, long-term forecasting, classification, and imputation.

name: CosyVoice
description: Alibaba Tongyi Lab's open-source multi-lingual generative speech model capable of zero-shot voice cloning with 3 seconds of reference audio, natural conversational prosody control, and multi-dialect voice synthesis.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; supports emotional voice generation, cross-lingual voice replication, and streaming real-time inference.

name: Yi-Coder
description: Open coding foundation model series by 01.AI available in 1.5B and 9B parameter sizes, trained on 2.4 trillion tokens and supporting long context lengths up to 128K tokens for repository-level comprehension and code generation across 52 languages.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; delivers impressive benchmark scores among sub-10B coding models on HumanEval and MBPP.

name: Llama 2
description: Meta AI's milestone open foundation model family available in 7B, 13B, and 70B parameter checkpoints, trained on 2 trillion tokens to establish the modern standard for open-weights research and commercial deployment.
notes: Provided under the Meta Llama 2 Community License Agreement; catalyzed the explosion of fine-tuned open-source models.

name: Mistral Small
description: Cost-efficient, enterprise-grade language model by Mistral AI engineered for low-latency reasoning, code generation, and function calling across multiple European and global languages.
notes: Available via Mistral's La Plateforme API and cloud hyperscalers (Azure, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI).

name: DeepSeek-Coder
description: First-generation open coding model family by DeepSeek (1.3B, 6.7B, 33B) trained from scratch on 2 trillion tokens of 87 programming languages with 16K project-level context windows and fill-in-the-middle support.
notes: Permissive DeepSeek license allowing commercial use; achieved state-of-the-art results among open coding models.

name: Claude 3 Opus
description: Anthropic's flagship high-intelligence model in the Claude 3 family, demonstrating near-human levels of comprehension and fluency across complex analysis, research synthesis, and specialized STEM reasoning tasks.
notes: Supports 200K token context windows with vision input understanding; available via Anthropic Console API and AWS Bedrock.

name: GPT-4 Turbo
description: OpenAI's high-capacity generative model supporting a 128K token context window, updated knowledge base, JSON mode, and unified vision and text processing capabilities for complex enterprise workloads.
notes: Predecessor to GPT-4o; provides deterministic seed parameters and reproducible completions via OpenAI API.

name: Gemini 2.0 Flash
description: Google's high-speed multimodal reasoning model designed for the agentic era, featuring native real-time audio and video streaming input/output, sub-second latency, and built-in tool execution capabilities.
notes: Available in Google AI Studio; powers bidirectional voice and visual streaming agent applications.

name: HQ-SAM (High-Quality SAM)
description: Upgraded segmentation model developed by ETH Zurich that enhances Meta's SAM with a High-Quality Output Token, generating extremely precise boundary segmentations for intricate objects like hair, ropes, and transparent items.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; reuses SAM's frozen weights while adding minimal parameter overhead for high-precision boundary refinement.

name: BLIP-2
description: Salesforce Research's foundational vision-language architecture using a Querying Transformer (Q-Former) to bridge frozen pre-trained vision encoders with frozen large language models with exceptional compute efficiency.
notes: BSD-3-Clause licensed; established the two-stage vision-language representation alignment technique.

name: InstructBLIP
description: Instruction-tuned vision-language model by Salesforce Research that incorporates instruction-aware visual feature extraction to understand complex multimodal user directions across 26 vision tasks.
notes: BSD-3-Clause licensed; integrates with Flan-T5 and Vicuna LLM backends.

name: Open-Sora
description: Open-source video generation initiative developed by HPC-AI Tech that democratizes efficient video diffusion models using Spatial-Temporal Diffusion Transformers (STDiT) to generate high-resolution video clips.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; supports video generation up to 720p resolution and arbitrary aspect ratios.

name: Stable Cascade
description: Stability AI's high-efficiency text-to-image foundation model built on the Würstchen architecture, utilizing a 42x compression latent stage to generate high-resolution 1024x1024 images faster and with less VRAM than standard models.
notes: Non-commercial research license; divides generation into Stage A (autoencoder), Stage B (latent compression), and Stage C (text conditioning).

name: SV3D (Stable Video 3D)
subtype: Generative Orbital Novel View & 3D Mesh Synthesis Model
description: Generative 3D model by Stability AI that transforms single still images into continuous 360-degree orbital novel view videos and exportable 3D textured meshes using camera-conditioned video diffusion.
notes: Available in SV3D_u (orbital novel view synthesis) and SV3D_p (specified camera trajectories) checkpoints.

name: Point-E
description: OpenAI's foundational 3D generation system that produces 3D colored point clouds from complex text prompts or 2D images in one to two minutes on a single GPU using two-stage diffusion pipelines.
notes: MIT licensed; includes point-cloud to triangle mesh conversion algorithms.

name: Shap-E
description: OpenAI's conditional diffusion model that generates the parameters of implicit functions (rendering both Neural Radiance Fields and textured 3D meshes) directly from text prompts or single images.
notes: MIT licensed; generates higher-fidelity continuous 3D surfaces compared to point cloud representations.

name: Conformer-CTC
description: NVIDIA NeMo's high-speed automatic speech recognition model family combining self-attention for global audio context with depthwise convolution layers to capture fine-grained local speech acoustics.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; delivers real-time streaming non-autoregressive transcription on edge and server GPUs.

name: UniAudio
subtype: Universal Generative Audio & Speech Foundation Model
description: Universal foundation model developed by Chinese University of Hong Kong that unifies 11 diverse audio generation and understanding tasks (ASR, TTS, sound generation, music editing, audio captioning) using discrete audio tokenization.
notes: Operates as a 1B LLM over unified discrete audio tokens, bridging the gap across disparate speech and sound tasks.

name: StarCoder
description: First-generation 15.5B parameter code generation foundation model developed by BigCode (Hugging Face & ServiceNow), trained on 1 trillion tokens across 80+ programming languages with 8K context and multi-query attention.
notes: Released under OpenRAIL-M v1 license with strict data governance allowing code attribution and opt-out.

name: CodeGeeX4
description: Open code generation foundation model series (9B parameters) developed by Zhipu AI, pre-trained on the GLM-4 architecture with 128K context support for repository-scale code completion, debugging, and cross-language translation.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; ranks among the strongest sub-10B coding models on SWE-bench Lite and HumanEval.

name: Snowflake Arctic
description: Snowflake's 480B parameter open Mixture-of-Experts foundation model that activates only 17B parameters per token using a 128-expert architecture designed for enterprise SQL generation, coding, and instruction compliance.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed including weights and training recipes; optimized for enterprise data lakehouse workloads.

name: Gemma 2 9B
description: Google's 9B parameter open foundation model in the Gemma 2 family, trained with knowledge distillation from larger teacher models and sliding-window local/global attention to punch above its weight class.
notes: Available under the Gemma Open Terms of Use; widely deployed for consumer GPU and enterprise on-premise inference.

name: Phi-3.5-MoE
description: Microsoft Research's lightweight open Mixture-of-Experts model containing 16x3.8B parameters (activating 6.6B parameters per token) with 128K context support, outperforming models twice its active size on multi-step reasoning.
notes: MIT licensed; trained on synthetic data and curated educational web literature.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B
description: Alibaba Cloud's flagship 32.5B parameter open code generation model matching GPT-4o level coding performance across benchmarks with 128K context window, 5.5 trillion training tokens, and support for 92 programming languages.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; recognized as one of the most capable open-weights coding models available for local developer hosting.

name: OpenCodeInterpreter
description: Open code generation suite developed by Tsinghua and Waterloo that integrates code execution feedback and compiler error logs into iterative multi-turn code refinement, bridging the gap to proprietary code interpreters.
notes: Checkpoints based on DeepSeek-Coder and CodeLlama with specialized execution tuning datasets.

name: CogVLM
description: Powerful open visual language foundation model that connects visual processing directly into the language model via a Visual Expert module in every Transformer layer, avoiding loss of image detail during projection.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed code; supports fine-grained visual grounding with pixel-level coordinate predictions.

name: DeepSeek-VL
description: Open vision-language model family (1.3B and 7B) by DeepSeek engineered for diverse real-world multimodal scenarios, including high-resolution document parsing, diagram understanding, and web UI layout reasoning.
notes: Permissive DeepSeek license allowing commercial use; processes arbitrary resolution images via hybrid tiling encoders.

name: LLaVA-NeXT-Video
description: Open-source video understanding model developed by the LLaVA team that extends image-language pre-training with spatio-temporal pooling to reason over long video sequences, action recognition, and temporal video QA.
notes: Supports zero-shot video dialogue with strong performance across Video-MME and ActivityNet QA benchmarks.

name: Video-ChatGPT
description: Multimodal conversational model by MBZUAI designed for detailed video dialogue, combining a spatio-temporal video encoder with Vicuna LLM to produce temporal descriptions, causal explanations, and creative video summaries.
notes: Released with the 100K Video-Instruction dataset and comprehensive quantitative video evaluation protocols.

name: AnimateDiff-Lightning
description: Distilled motion model developed by ByteDance that accelerates video generation from text prompts and still images, reducing AnimateDiff sampling requirements to 1, 2, 4, or 8 steps with zero loss in visual quality.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed checkpoints compatible with arbitrary Stable Diffusion v1.5 community checkpoints.

name: Stable Audio 2.0
description: Generative audio model by Stability AI capable of producing up to three minutes of structured full-length music, ambient sound effects, and audio-to-audio style transformations at 44.1 kHz stereo from text descriptions.
notes: Trained exclusively on licensed AudioSparx library audio to guarantee copyright safety for commercial creators.

name: AudioLDM 2
subtype: General Audio, Music, & Speech Latent Diffusion Model
description: Latent diffusion model developed by University of Surrey and Imperial College London utilizing Language of Audio (LOA) representations to unify sound effects, musical compositions, and spoken text generation.
notes: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 licensed; checkpoints include AudioLDM-2-Large and specialized AudioLDM-2-Music.

name: MusicGen-Melody
description: Specialized autoregressive model by Meta AI that accepts both textual prompts and reference audio melodies (humming, whistling, guitar chords) to generate conditioned stereo music adhering to the reference melodic contour.
notes: MIT licensed code with weights for non-commercial research; released within Meta's AudioCraft framework.

name: Graphormer
description: Microsoft Research's standard-setting Transformer architecture for graph-structured data and molecular chemistry, winning the Open Catalyst Challenge and OGB Large-Scale Challenge for quantum chemistry property prediction.
notes: MIT licensed; incorporates centrality encoding and spatial encoding to model 3D molecular graph geometry.

name: Llama 3.3 70B
description: Meta AI's 70B parameter open foundation model that delivers benchmark reasoning and coding capabilities matching the previous 405B flagship model at significantly reduced computational serving costs.
notes: Available under the Llama 3.3 Community License; supports 128K context window with high multilingual fluency.

name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen
description: Family of open reasoning models (1.5B, 7B, 14B, 32B) distilled by DeepSeek from DeepSeek-R1 outputs using Qwen2.5 base checkpoints, bringing frontier chain-of-thought mathematical reasoning to accessible model sizes.
notes: MIT licensed; outperforms OpenAI o1-mini on competitive mathematics benchmarks (AIME, MATH-500).

name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama
description: Open reasoning models (8B and 70B parameter sizes) distilled from DeepSeek-R1 onto Meta's Llama 3.1 architecture, demonstrating state-of-the-art chain-of-thought mathematical, coding, and logical reasoning.
notes: Permissive Llama 3.1 Community License; accessible for consumer GPU execution with llama.cpp or vLLM.

name: Mistral Large 2
description: Mistral AI's flagship 123B dense language model featuring a 128K context window, advanced multilingual fluency across 80+ coding languages, and state-of-the-art reasoning on code and math benchmarks.
notes: Available under the Mistral Research License for academic use and via Mistral API / cloud hyperscalers for commercial deployments.

name: Codestral Mamba
subtype: Mamba2 State Space Code Generation Model
description: Open code model built on the Mamba2 State Space Model (SSM) architecture by Mistral AI, delivering linear-time scaling with context length and fast token generation with 256K token context windows.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; delivers fast inference regardless of input context length due to state-space formulation.

name: Gemma 2 27B
description: Google DeepMind's flagship 27B parameter dense open model that outperforms larger 70B models on reasoning, instruction following, and factual QA benchmarks while running comfortably on single consumer GPUs.
notes: Released under the Gemma Open Terms of Use; features alternating local sliding window attention and global attention.

name: Qwen2-VL-72B
description: Alibaba Cloud's flagship 72B multimodal vision-language model featuring Dynamic Resolution visual processing to understand videos over 20 minutes, complex charts, web UI screenshots, and multilingual text in images.
notes: Scores near GPT-4o on visual document and math benchmarks (DocVQA, MathVista, Video-MME).

name: InternLM2.5
description: Open-source foundation model series (7B and 20B) by Shanghai AI Lab featuring native 1-million-token context windows, outstanding tool-use abilities, and state-of-the-art mathematical and coding reasoning.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; includes native support for agentic tool use and deep document analysis.

name: Claude 3 Haiku
description: Anthropic's compact, ultra-fast multimodal model engineered to process long-context documents and high-resolution images with near-instantaneous response times and industry-leading cost efficiency.
notes: Supports 200K token context windows; widely used in high-volume customer service and enterprise document extraction.

name: Whisper-Large-v2
description: OpenAI's milestone 1.55B parameter automatic speech recognition foundation model, trained on 680,000 hours of labeled multilingual audio with high robustness to accents, background noise, and technical jargon.
notes: MIT licensed; established the global benchmark for open-source multilingual speech recognition and translation.

name: BGE-Large-EN-v1.5
subtype: High-Accuracy English Dense Text Embedding Model
description: Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI) flagship 335M parameter dense embedding model optimized for English semantic search, ranking at the top of the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB).
notes: MIT licensed; produces 1024-dimensional normalized vector embeddings widely used in production RAG systems.

name: Jina-Reranker-v2
description: High-speed cross-encoder reranker model designed by Jina AI supporting 100+ languages and 1024 token query-document pairs, boosting search retrieval accuracy and precision in complex RAG pipelines.
notes: CC-BY-NC-4.0 / commercial API license; outscores dense retrievers by evaluating cross-attention interaction.

name: CRM (Convolutional Reconstruction Model)
subtype: Single Image to High-Fidelity 3D Textured Mesh Model
description: Feed-forward 3D generative model by Tsinghua and Shengshu that converts a single input image into a complete, high-fidelity 3D textured mesh in just 10 seconds without test-time optimization.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; predicts canonical multi-view coordinate maps to reconstruct clean watertight 3D geometry.

name: OpenShape
description: Groundbreaking multi-modal foundation model aligning 3D shapes with text and image representations across millions of 3D objects, enabling zero-shot 3D classification, retrieval, and text-guided 3D editing.
notes: MIT licensed; trained on Enriched ShapeNet and Objaverse datasets using contrastive representation learning.

name: MobileVLM
description: Fast multimodal vision-language model architecture engineered by Meituan for mobile and edge devices, utilizing lightweight MobileNetV4/MobileLLaMA backbones to achieve real-time visual chat on consumer hardware.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; delivers up to 21.5 tokens/sec on Qualcomm Snapdragon smartphone processors.

name: RT-2 (Robotic Transformer 2)
description: Pioneering Vision-Language-Action model by Google DeepMind that transfers web-scale multimodal pre-training directly into robotic control commands, enabling robots to perform generalized physical manipulation from natural instructions.
notes: Casts robot motor actions directly as text tokens in output language space, enabling emergent physical tool use.

name: Llama 3.2-Vision
description: Meta AI's open vision-language models (11B and 90B parameters) capable of visual reasoning, high-resolution document parsing, chart understanding, and image captioning on par with proprietary commercial VLMs.
notes: Available under Llama 3.2 Community License; integrates image encoder adapters with text reasoning backbones.

name: Qwen2.5-1M
description: Alibaba Cloud's open-weights model series (7B and 14B) pre-trained with 1-million-token context windows, achieving high needle-in-a-haystack retrieval and long-document reasoning without context degradation.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; enables entire codebases, financial filings, and novels to be fed directly into single prompts.

name: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite
description: Compact Mixture-of-Experts coding model by DeepSeek containing 16B total parameters (activating only 2.4B parameters per token) with 128K context window, running at high speed on consumer desktop GPUs.
notes: DeepSeek license allowing commercial use; provides superior coding benchmark scores among models with <3B active parameters.

name: Gemma 2 2B
description: Google DeepMind's ultra-compact 2.6B parameter language model distilled from larger Gemma 2 architectures, engineered for high-throughput on-device inference on laptops, mobile phones, and edge accelerators.
notes: Gemma Open Terms of Use; runs natively inside WebGPU browsers and mobile devices with MediaPipe.

name: Phi-3.5-Vision
description: Microsoft Research's 4.2B parameter lightweight multimodal model supporting multi-image and multi-frame video reasoning with a 128K context window, excelling at chart analysis and OCR text parsing.
notes: MIT licensed; integrates a 16-crop dynamic image tokenization strategy for ultra-high-resolution inputs.

name: Yi-Large
description: 01.AI's flagship proprietary foundation model, demonstrating competitive performance with GPT-4 and Claude 3.5 Sonnet on LMSYS Chatbot Arena benchmarks across bilingual English and Chinese reasoning.
notes: Served via the 01.AI API platform; ranked among the top global closed models on multilingual evaluations.

name: Granite 3.0
description: IBM Research's enterprise-grade open model series (2B and 8B dense, plus MoE variants) pre-trained on 12 trillion tokens of business, academic, and code data with enterprise copyright indemnity guarantees.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; fully transparent training datasets and comprehensive corporate indemnity.

name: Nemotron-4 340B
subtype: Open Model Family for Synthetic Data Generation
